ModMetaData.name: Pit Gate Dumping
ModMetaData.author: 1trickPwnyta
ModMetaData.description:
Automates the selection of items on the map, such as wastepacks, to dump into pit gates etc.
Pit gates have a Dumping tab similar to the Storage tab for stockpiles that lets you choose what kinds of things to dump into the pit gate. Pawns will automatically dump those things in as part of the hauling job.
The ancient hatches and insect cave entrances from Odyssey are also supported, as are the cave exit ropes/ladders so you can automatically send things back up to the surface as well.
